311s1.name_ru: Государственная юридическая помощь и расходы на судебные процессы для граждан
311s1.name_en: State-funded legal aid and court costs for individuals
311s1.plus_en: Widens who receives state-funded legal aid or lowers what individuals pay to go to court: legal aid for victims of sexual offences, domestic violence, fraud, hostile acts and other crimes, for nursing-care patients and for plaintiffs in discrimination or civil cases, state funding of experts, guardians' fees and family-court proceedings, exemptions from court fees, longer or extended legal-aid temporary provisions.
311s1.minus_en: Narrows who receives state-funded legal aid or raises what individuals pay to go to court (e.g. denies legal aid to husbands who refuse to grant a divorce).

311s2.name_ru: Доступ к адвокату и государственное представительство для задержанных и обвиняемых по делам безопасности и террора
311s2.name_en: Access to a lawyer and state-funded representation for security and terror detainees
311s2.plus_en: Gives people detained, suspected, accused or convicted of terror or security offences (including unlawful combatants) more access to a lawyer, shorter periods in which a meeting with a lawyer may be withheld, or state-funded legal representation.
311s2.minus_en: Lets the authorities withhold or postpone meetings with a lawyer for such detainees, extends emergency regulations that allow this, or bars state funding of legal representation for terrorists and security-offence suspects.

230s1.plus_en: Makes loans easier or cheaper for individuals and families: easier mortgage terms and higher financing ratios, state guarantees or loans for a first or only home, interest-free or state loans for tuition, driving lessons, home protection or bereaved families, cheaper overdraft loans, social lending services, shorter retention or exclusion of negative data in credit-data registries.
230s1.minus_en: Makes loans harder or more expensive for individuals and families: stricter mortgage terms or financing caps, fewer state loans or guarantees for households, longer retention of negative credit data.

230s2.name_en: Credit and financing for businesses and the capital market
230s2.plus_en: Makes credit and financing easier to obtain for businesses: securitization and factoring rules, more competition among lenders and licences for non-bank and foreign providers, measures to encourage capital-market activity, financial backing of developers by payment-service providers, state-guaranteed business loans in emergencies.
230s2.minus_en: Makes business credit and financing harder to obtain: more barriers for non-bank and foreign lenders, fewer financing instruments, no state guarantees for business loans.
